title: NSFAS is late
text: The 25th has come and gone and your NSFAS allowance has not landed. The res group chat is one long sigh with a lot of crying emojis.

choices.label: Stretch what you have
choices.result: Bread, peanut butter and patience. You discover that two-minute noodles can be a personality.

choices.label: Borrow R50 from a friend
choices.result: A friend sends it with a voice note. The voice note is four minutes of advice, but the R50 is real.

title: Load shedding at the library
text: Stage 4. The lights die mid-paragraph, the library goes silent, and the generator coughs once and gives up.

choices.label: Study by phone torch
choices.result: Half a chapter in a small circle of light, at 11% battery. Somehow it sticks.

choices.label: Sit outside with everyone
choices.result: Someone has a speaker, someone has a story, and nobody remembers which chapter was due.

title: Surprise test
text: The lecturer smiles in that specific way. "Notes closed, phones away." Forty people stop breathing at once.

choices.label: Write what you know
choices.result: Not pretty, but the page is full and your pen survived. That counts.

choices.label: Peek at your neighbour
choices.result: They saw you. The whole row saw you. The lecturer definitely saw you.

title: Res Wi-Fi is down
text: The router blinks orange like it is judging you. Your assignment is due at midnight and the portal will not load.

choices.label: Buy data and push through
choices.result: R60 of data later it is submitted, with four minutes to spare. Breathe.

choices.label: Ask the lecturer for an extension
choices.result: A very polite email, then a very short reply: "Fine. Monday."

title: A friend needs R50
text: The friend from next door is short for taxi fare home this weekend. They look at their shoes while they ask.

choices.label: Send the R50
choices.result: "I owe you big." You believe them, mostly, and you are fine with that.

choices.label: Say you are broke too
choices.result: They nod. It is true for everyone, a little, and nobody says it out loud.

title: Cafeteria special
text: Bunny chow special: half price until two. The queue is already round the corner and past the notice board.

choices.label: Join the queue
choices.result: Worth every minute. The gravy is a hug and the bread is the best part.

choices.label: Skip it and save
choices.result: Your stomach files a formal complaint and copies in your wallet.

title: Bursary email
text: Subject line: "Application window closes Friday." It wants a motivation letter, two signatures and a certified copy of everything you own.

choices.label: Write the letter tonight
choices.result: Submitted at 23:58. A small first payment lands as a book allowance.

choices.label: Leave it for later
choices.result: Later becomes never. You try very hard not to think about it.

title: Durban rain
text: The sky opens all at once, the way it only does here. Everyone runs for the nearest roof and the taxi rank turns into a river.

choices.label: Wait it out with a stranger
choices.result: Ten minutes under the awning and you leave with a new friend and a better umbrella plan.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.result: Soaked to the socks, but on time. Your shoes squeak for the rest of the day.

title: Derby Day
text: Sunday. Gold or Black. The whole campus is loud either way and nobody has studied.

choices.label: Wear Gold
choices.result: Gold. The Quad answers back and a stranger high-fives you for no reason.

choices.label: Wear Black
choices.result: Black. Somebody lends you a scarf and a very strong opinion.
